name: Circle of West Binding
summary: Near Thoradin's Wall, Burning Exiles overrun the Circle of West Binding and guard its stone. The ancient ritual site is one of several scattered across the Arathi Highlands.

sections.title: The Western Keystone
sections.body: Near Thoradin's Wall, the Stone of West Binding stands at the Circle of West Binding. The site belongs to a wider network of ancient ritual places scattered across the Arathi Highlands. Burning Exiles overrun the grounds and guard the stone. Their fiery presence makes an approach perilous for travelers crossing the western plains.

faq.q: What is the Circle of West Binding?
faq.answer: The Circle of West Binding is an ancient ritual site in western Arathi Highlands, near Thoradin's Wall. The Stone of West Binding stands there, guarded by hostile fire elementals.

faq.q: Why are there fire elementals here?
faq.answer: The Burning Exiles inhabit and guard the Stone of West Binding. These elemental forces are drawn or bound to ancient magical foci built across the Arathi Highlands.
Ruul Onestone is a Boulderfist ogre mage who prowls the site. He is a rare and dangerous brute, not a scholar of the binding stone.

angles.text: As a mage, you can find insight in Arathi's binding stones into how ancient mages and shamans anchored and subdued planar elemental entities.
As a shaman, you can read the Burning Exiles' volatile presence as a sign of elemental unrest still tethered to these ancient Arathi keystones.
